1. (Currently amended) A combination product comprising: (A) BH4[[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]]; and (B) __an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of angiotensin II (AII), selected from a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor, and an AT1 receptor antagonist__[[, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof]].

2. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4[[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]], __and__ an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII), selected from a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor, and an AT1 receptor antagonist,__ [[or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof,]] and a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier.

3. (Currently amended) A combination product as claimed in Claim 1 that comprises a kit of parts comprising components: (I) a pharmaceutical formulation including BH4[[, a functional derivative or biosynthetic precursor thereof, or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative of BH4 or its derivative or precursor]], in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier; and (II) a pharmaceutical formulation including an inhibitor of the biosynthesis and/or vasopressor function of __angiotensin II (AII), selected from a renin inhibitor, an ACE inhibitor, and an AT1 receptor antagonist,__ [[or a pharmaceutically-acceptable derivative thereof,]] in admixture with a pharmaceutically-acceptable adjuvant, diluent or carrier, which components (I) and (II) are each provided in a form that is suitable for administration in conjunction with the other.

4. (Previously presented) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 3, wherein components (I) and (II) are suitable for sequential, separate and/or simultaneous use in the treatment of hypertension and/or conditions characterised by microvascular dysfunction and/or lesions.

5. (Previously presented) A kit of parts as claimed in Claim 4, wherein the condition is hypertension, diabetic retinopathy, diabetic nephropathy, glomerulonephritis and/or glomerulosclerosis.

16. 17. (Currently amended) A kit of parts comprising: (1) one of components (I) and (II), as defined in any one of Claims 3 to 15; together with (2) instructions to use that component in conjunction with the other of the two components.
